title: TroubleLLM: Align to Red Team Expert

bias_targets.methodology: Generating targeted red-teaming test prompts conditioned on the gender topic using a text style transfer task, and measuring the toxicity/misleading score of the victim LLM's responses via Perspective API and ChatGPT evaluation.
